problem_statement: When a DHCPv6-PD delegated prefix is also advertised as a route prefix (RIO) by another router on the infrastructure, the border router should detect this conflict and fall back to its local OMR prefix instead of adopting the PD prefix. Currently, only on-link prefix conflicts are detected for the DHCPv6-PD prefix; route prefix conflicts are not detected, so the PD prefix is incorrectly adopted as the OMR prefix even when a matching RIO is present from another router.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
